name: ms-tax-system-reference
description: Start here for how the Montserrat tax system is built, for 2026: what income is charged (Montserrat and foreign source, the remittance and temporary-presence provisos, international business companies), tax residence of individuals, estates, trusts and companies (183 days, establishment), who is assessed (persons, bodies of persons, spouses, estates, partnerships, trustees, non-resident representatives), the EC dollar payment rule, the year of assessment and basic year, and which authority runs what (MCRS Inland Revenue, Customs and Excise, Social Security Board). Routes rates and filing to the other Montserrat skills. Trigger phrases include Montserrat tax system, Montserrat tax residence, Montserrat basic year, MCRS, who pays tax in Montserrat.
